input: We are a dental clinic (legal entity). I want to post the before and after of our patients' dental contact lenses (veneers) with 'from R$ 299 per veneer, this month only'.

checks.description: Grounds the answer in the dentistry council rules
Cites CFO Resolution 196/2019 on result images
Explains that publishing result images by a clinic (legal entity) is prohibited
Points out that price and discounts as a hook remain prohibited
